experiment: Amortize shape-table compaction and retain live method caches across ordinary GC
decision: Retain as a measured Stage B candidate. The 50% unreachable-shape threshold halves RayTrace shape compactions and improves its Score; Splay retains a 15 MiB RSS reduction. Score and RSS intervals show no statistically clear regression in the measured fixtures. This is not Task 61 qualification.

source.candidate_build_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/iteration/task61-shape-compaction-half cargo build --profile production -p quench-node --bin quench-node
source.candidate_profile_memory_build_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/iteration/task61-shape-compaction-half cargo build --profile production -p quench-node --features quench-node/profile-memory --bin quench-node
source.implementation: After mark/sweep, compute live object shape ancestry. Preserve shape IDs and shape-keyed field/add/holder caches unless at least half of the shape table is unreachable. On ordinary collections, prune method-cache entries whose heap handles died; on shape compaction, remap live object shapes and clear shape-keyed caches. Compact the property arena independently at its existing post-GC cleanup point.
source.threshold_basis: A symbolized RayTrace allocation trace showed 40–43% of shapes unreachable at each collection. A 50% cutoff amortizes the repeated rebuild while ensuring accumulated dead shapes eventually trigger compaction.

measurement.kind: 11 alternating production binary pairs per fixture; baseline and candidate order alternated each round
measurement.backend: /usr/bin/time -lp (Score from the benchmark runner, elapsed time, maximum RSS, instructions retired)
measurement.paired_interval: 100,000 paired bootstrap resamples; reported intervals are 95% intervals for the median paired change. Score/instructions/time are paired percent changes; RSS is paired absolute MiB change.
